d:
The Lakers defeated the Hawks, 124-114 tonight in Atlanta. Luka Dončić finished with a team-high 32 points along with 10 assists and 8 rebounds for the Lakers, while Sandro Mamukelashvili tallied 23 points, 8 rebounds and 5 three pointers in the game. CJ McCollum recorded 21 points, 4 assists and 3 three pointers. The Lakers improve their record to 10-2 with the win, while the Hawks fall to 7-5 for the season.
